            if res == true or res == BT.SUCCESS then
                return BT.SUCCESS
            elseif res == false or res == BT.FAILURE then
                return BT.FAILURE
            elseif res == BT.RUNNING then

        end,
        reset = function()

        end
    }
end

--- Condition node ---------------------------------------------------------

            if predicate(ctx) then

        reset = function()
